categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: electronic components distribution, chip design and manufacturing, software development and sales, and smart control products for household appliances. The electronic components distribution segment is the largest, serving industries such as consumer electronics, automotive, industrial, and medical. The chip design and manufacturing segment focuses on MEMS micro-mirrors and automotive display driver chips (DDIC and TDDI). Software development includes ERP, MES, and WMS systems tailored for electronics manufacturing and distribution.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor design and manufacturing technologies, including MEMS (Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems) micro-mirror technology with electromagnetic drive for laser scanning applications. It also develops automotive-grade display driver integrated circuits (DDIC and TDDI) with high precision touch capabilities. Manufacturing includes IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) and fabless models, with wafer production and packaging localized in China and Japan. Software products are developed using AI technologies integrating large language models for intelligent customer service and data analysis.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the automotive industry, consumer electronics manufacturers (smartphones, smart wearables), industrial automation, medical devices, and smart transportation sectors. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international clients, including Japanese and American companies. The automotive segment is growing rapidly, especially in new energy vehicles and intelligent driving systems, driving demand for the company's chips and components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, with significant business in Hong Kong, Japan, and the United States. It has subsidiaries and offices in Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Tokyo, and the US. Its supply chain and manufacturing are localized primarily in China and Japan, with sales covering domestic and overseas markets. The company also has operations in BVI and other regions for investment and trade purposes.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and midstream in the semiconductor and electronic components supply chain. It acts as a distributor (midstream) connecting upstream original manufacturers with downstream customers, and also as a chip designer and manufacturer (upstream) producing MEMS devices and automotive display driver chips. It integrates R&D, manufacturing, packaging, and sales, aiming to be a full semiconductor IDM enterprise.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on transforming from a distributor to a full semiconductor IDM enterprise, emphasizing R&D in MEMS micro-mirrors and automotive display driver chips to achieve domestic substitution of imported products. It invests heavily in chip design, manufacturing capacity localization, and AI-enabled software solutions. The company plans to accelerate chip mass production, expand application scenarios for MEMS devices, and explore mergers and acquisitions to consolidate semiconductor industry resources.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electronic components and semiconductor chips, including distribution commissions and product sales. The company also earns income from software licensing, development, and maintenance services. It operates mainly on a direct sales model supported by a strong supply chain and technical service capabilities. Additionally, it receives government subsidies and occasional investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with Taiwanese and Korean suppliers in the automotive display chip market but leverages its local supply chain and cost advantages to gain market share in China. It is positioned as a leading domestic electronic components distributor with expanding semiconductor design and manufacturing capabilities. Its strategic partnerships, such as with Synaptics, and its focus on domestic substitution position it as a rising competitor in the semiconductor IDM space.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 5.35 billion, a 7.83% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 60.27 million, up 9.84%. The chip design and manufacturing segment grew by over 25%, reflecting accelerated R&D and production. The company maintains a stable asset base of around RMB 3.59 billion and continues to increase R&D investment significantly, indicating a growth trajectory focused on innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop service in the semiconductor supply chain, combining extensive distribution networks with proprietary chip design and manufacturing. Its MEMS micro-mirror technology offers compact, low-power, and cost-effective solutions for automotive and industrial applications. The automotive display chips provide superior touch performance under challenging conditions, supporting domestic substitution of foreign products. Its AI-driven software solutions enhance operational efficiency for electronics manufacturers and distributors, creating differentiated value through integrated technology and service capabilities.
